about: QA W1: a deleted (redacted) message is not a pin. Shared byte-for-byte by the desktop (crates/app/src/testvectors/pins.json) and the web (src/features/chat/lib/testvectors/pins.json); pins.rs / pins.ts replay it.

rowBody.why: a plain message shows its text
deleted in an encrypted room: a redaction keeps the m.room.encrypted type and drops the content, it is gone, not waiting for a key

rowBody.want: Encrypted message — open the room around it to read it

shown.why: a deleted pin neither counts nor lists
a deleted message that is not pinned changes nothing

afterDelete.why: deleting a pinned message unpins it when I may edit the pins
the last pin: an empty list is written
no pins at all: no write
I may not edit the pins: no write (the deleted pin is only hidden)
